# Shine a Light

> Shine a Light documents recovery advocacy and community service initiatives addressing homelessness and addiction support in Las Vegas.

Shine a Light is a Las Vegas-based organization focused on recovery advocacy and homeless outreach. The site features stories of individuals like Paul Vautrinot who are making a difference in the community through addiction support and service to vulnerable populations.

## Key Topics

- Homelessness
- Recovery advocacy
- Las Vegas
- Community service
- Addiction support
- Homeless outreach
- Paul Vautrinot
- City of Las Vegas
- FOX5Vegas
- Social impact

## Recovery & Advocacy Stories

- [Recovering addict helps homeless people](https://www.shinealightlv.com/news/recovering-addict-helps-homeless-people): Paul Vautrinot's recovery advocacy work helping homeless people in Las Vegas
